glossary.definition: PingFederate 13.1 built-in system tag (_pf_system_tag_ai_agent) used to identify OAuth clients that are AI agents, filterable through the Admin API.
The proposed connector synchronizes tagged OAuth clients from PingFederate into PingIDM only; PingIDM changes never flow back.
A managed identity record in PingIDM created for each AI-agent-tagged OAuth client — the foundation for ownership, privileges and lifecycle management.
